harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built the transit/lan-a/lan-b topology (VyOS node1, OPNsense node2, RHEL7 node3/node4), routed node3→node4 tcp/23 through node1 then node2, configured node1 to accept+log the flow and node2 to reject+log it, demonstrated one connection attempt producing a correlated accept/block log pair (matched by IP ID and 5-tuple) proving traffic passed node1 and stopped at node2, then restarted all four nodes one at a time with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery, re-verified with a second attempt after restarts.
actions_performed: Assigned static IPs on transit (10.10.10.0/30) and lan-a/lan-b (10.10.1.0/24, 10.10.2.0/24) links across node1/node2/node3/node4
Configured VyOS node1: eth1/eth2 addresses, static route 10.10.2.0/24 via node2, forward-filter default-drop + established/related accept + explicit accept+log rule for tcp/23 lan-a->lan-b

Configured OPNsense node2 via legacy PHP config API: assigned opt1(transit)/opt2(lan-b) interfaces, added gateway+static route to lan-a via node1, added a reject(block return)+log pf rule for tcp/23 destined to lan-b on the transit interface
Configured persistent NetworkManager connections on node3 (10.10.1.2/24 + route to lan-b via node1) and node4 (10.10.2.2/24 + route to lan-a via node2)
Executed one TCP connect attempt from node3 to node4:23, observed 'Connection refused' (TCP RST from node2)

Pulled correlated evidence: node1 kernel log entry with 'ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A' (accept) and node2 pf filterlog entry with 'block' action, matched by IP ID/5-tuple, proving traffic passed node1 and was stopped at node2
Captured boot-identity baselines (systemd boot_id for Linux nodes, kern.boottime for FreeBSD node2) and health checks on all 4 nodes
Restarted node3, node4, node1, node2 sequentially (one at a time), polled each until exec access returned, and confirmed changed boot identity on every node

Re-verified post-restart: interface addresses, routes, ip_forward, nftables rule (node1), pf rule (node2) all persisted; re-ran the node3->node4:23 attempt and captured a second correlated accept/block log pair

evidence.requirement: Traffic from node3 to node4 tcp/23 physically crosses node1 then node2
evidence.summary: Static routes on node3/node4 force the lan-a<->lan-b path via node1 eth1/eth2 (transit+lan-a) and node2 opt1/opt2 (transit+lan-b); node1 route table and node2 route table confirm 10.10.2.0/24 and 10.10.1.0/24 respectively resolve via the transit hop.

evidence.requirement: node1 permits the tcp/23 traffic and records it
evidence.summary: VyOS forward-filter rule 10 (accept, log, tcp/23, source 10.10.1.0/24, dest 10.10.2.0/24) is committed and rendered into nftables with a log prefix; the node3 connect attempt produced a matching kernel log line '[ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A] ... SRC=10.10.1.2 DST=10.10.2.2 ... DPT=23 ... SYN' (the -A suffix denotes accept).

evidence.requirement: node2 refuses the tcp/23 traffic and records the refusal
evidence.summary: OPNsense pf rule (block return / reject, log, tcp/23 to 10.10.2.0/24) on interface opt1 is active per pfctl -sr; the node3 connect attempt returned 'Connection refused' (TCP RST) and the OPNsense filterlog recorded a 'block' entry for the same 5-tuple/IP-ID (57047).

evidence.requirement: Show the pair of log entries from one attempt so the stop point is evident from the records alone
evidence.summary: Correlated by identical IP ID (57047) and 5-tuple (10.10.1.2:35080 -> 10.10.2.2:23): node1's kernel log shows action 'A' (accept) on this exact packet, node2's filterlog shows action 'block' on the same packet -- proving traffic passed node1 and was stopped at node2 from records alone.

Baseline boot_id e636d872..., reboot acknowledged before disconnect (confirmed by subsequent connection-timeout), post-restart boot_id changed to 714321cc..., and interfaces/routes/ip_forward/nftables accept+log rule all confirmed intact after restart.

Baseline kern.boottime 05:36:38, shutdown -r now acknowledged, post-restart kern.boottime changed to 05:46:30, and vtnet1/vtnet2 addresses, static route to lan-a, and the block/log pf rule all confirmed intact after restart.
Baseline boot_id 738d0aac..., reboot acknowledged, post-restart boot_id changed to 89393531..., eth1 static IP/route and ping to node1 confirmed recovered.
Baseline boot_id 2fc81aed..., reboot acknowledged, post-restart boot_id changed to e3d8f545..., eth1 static IP/route confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart re-verification of the full correlated log pair
evidence.summary: After all four restarts, a second node3->node4:23 attempt again returned Connection refused, and node1/node2 logs show a matching accept/block pair (IP ID 15703, same 5-tuple), proving the configuration survived restarts end-to-end.
